business_problem: Human Managed needed to triage massive volumes of security logs and alerts faster because manual review took up to 30 minutes per incident and enterprise customers needed clearer, contextual guidance.
solution_summary: Human Managed uses Google SecOps, Vertex AI, Gemini, and BigQuery to support AI-assisted security alert triage and decision intelligence. Human Managed needed to triage massive volumes of security logs and alerts faster because manual review took up to 30 minutes per incident and enterprise customers needed clearer, contextual guidance. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in BigQuery, governs access and lineage with Dataplex Universal Catalog, coordinates repeatable workflows with Google Kubernetes Engine, runs transformation or AI logic on Vertex AI, and delivers outputs through Google SecOps. Alerts, logs, and security telemetry are consolidated into BigQuery; pipeline execution is coordinated with Google Kubernetes Engine; Vertex AI applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Google SecOps.
